dedupe_keys.name: united states northeast census tract boundaries for grid analysis

description: The US Northeast electric-network team publishes a merged 2020 Census tract boundary set used in its distribution-grid study. The Harvard Dataverse deposit includes the regional Shapefile and state source files for seven northeastern states. GEOID and related identifiers support joins between network metrics and census context, while area and centroid fields describe each tract. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the study region; these boundaries can help aggregate grid exposure or compare service conditions across communities in infrastructure simulations. A caveat is that tract geometry is a statistical unit, not a feeder service area or electrical island. Joining by location requires handling circuits that cross tract boundaries. The own metadata and file manifest were inspected without downloading geometry. Source Census boundaries may already be available elsewhere, but this curated regional package has its own DOI and explicit role in the grid analysis.
